items.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Incidentally, Stockenhausen and I became pretty good friends.

ctx.x: This finds us pretty much at the beginning of the ’70s, and to set the stage a little bit . . .
Incidentally, Stockenhausen and I became pretty good friends.
How did you find him? Tell us a little bit about him, I mean, just in terms of any remembrance that you may have.
